data.text:
To our Eco-CARAT Warriors 💎♻️

Our hearts are full of gratitude for everyone who supported our recycling initiative during Carat’s Quest. Because of your enthusiasm, cooperation, and love for the environment, we were able to collect a total of 564 PET bottles throughout the two-day event!

Collection breakdown:
Day 1 — 217 bottles
Day 2 — 347 bottles

What started as a simple activity turned into something truly meaningful because of you. Every bottle you brought and every step you took to participate helped reduce plastic waste and support environmental sustainability. 🌱✨

This initiative would not have been possible without the support of our partner. Thank you to the Rotaract Club of Quezon City for working with us to make this project possible and for helping us turn our shared advocacy for the environment into action.

We would also like to extend our gratitude to our venue partner, Trinoma by Ayala Malls, for providing the space and supporting initiatives that bring communities together for a good cause.

Your efforts show that CARATs are not only passionate fans but also individuals who care for the community and the planet. Together, we proved that fandom can be a powerful force for good.

From the bottom of our hearts, thank you for being part of this meaningful initiative. We are incredibly proud of our Eco-CARAT Warriors! 💙

And this is only the beginning — watch out for our next collaboration and more meaningful activities together! ✨

🌱 Because CARATs shine brightest when we care for the Earth together.

BREEZY? NU-UH BEFORE THE HIKE!

LOOK │Motorists along Doña Soledad Avenue in Parañaque City are caught in a scenario usually being experienced in the daytime - heavy traffic. 

The heavy congestion on Monday night is due to the number of cars piling up for gas before another big-time oil price hike takes effect tomorrow. 

A counterflow scheme has been implemented to allow cars en route to subdivisions pass through the highway and avoid the long line. │via Rolando Ng III
